basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old graphic designer based in Portland, Oregon, and a proud owner of two adorable rats named Squeak and Nibble. I've been fascinated by rodents ever since I volunteered at a local animal shelter during college. When I'm not working on digital art projects, you can find me exploring the beautiful hiking trails around my city or indulging in my love for retro video games. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and on weekends. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my free time with friends or attending local art exhibitions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in graphic design and a passion for visual storytelling, which I honed through both formal education and self-taught courses online. My interest in animals, particularly rodents, grew through volunteer work at an animal shelter and personal research.
